title: 第十一章雷云兽第十二章惊变
content_zh:
;;
赛后第六天，秦枫从宗内任务堂门前经过时，遇上了一名秦家分支子弟——秦一帆。秦一帆已有筑基初期的修为，平日里在族里的聚会上，秦枫也偶尔见过他，算是面熟。
此时，秦一帆正站在任务堂外的公告栏前，眉头紧锁地看着一则任务告示。告示上写着：前往云鼎山脉，捕杀一只筑基初期的雷云兽幼崽。任务奖励：一千贡献点以及一枚凡品破阶丹。秦一帆看到秦枫，眼睛一亮，连忙走了过来，热情地打招呼：“秦枫？你也来接任务？”秦枫摇了摇头，笑道：“我只是随便看看。”
秦一帆犹豫了一下，还是开口说道：“秦枫，我现在正在组队，准备去完成这则捕杀雷云兽幼崽的任务。我们已经有六个人了，还缺一个。你要不要一起？”他顿了顿，又补充道：“你的修为虽然只是练气十层，但我知道，你的真实战力，绝对不比一般的筑基修士差。有你加入，我们的把握会大很多。”秦枫心中一动。他这些年一直在宗门内修炼，很少有机会真正面对外界的妖兽。这次任务，不仅可以让他找一个练习的对象，还能让他见识一下宗外的世界，对他来说，有着极大的吸引力。
“好。”他没有犹豫，便答应了下来，“算我一个。”
秦一帆大喜：“太好了！那我们明天一早，在山门集合，乘坐飞舟出发！”
第二天一早，秦枫和秦一帆等七人在山门处汇合。同行的，还有另外五名筑基期弟子，其中一人是阵法师。七人寒暄了几句，便一同登上了宗门提供的飞舟。飞舟腾空而起，化作一道流光，朝着东北方向的云鼎山脉飞去。
谁也没有注意到，在飞舟飞出后，紫徽阁一道模糊的暗影一闪而过，随后化作一道细微的流光，悄无声息地跟在了飞舟后面。
刚开始，离开宗门的秦枫，心中还有些发慌。他自记事起，便一直在玉龙仙山长大，十几年来，从未离开过宗门半步。如今，突然要前往陌生的地方，他心中难免有些紧张。
但随着飞舟不断前行，那些奇奇怪怪的景象，渐渐吸引了他的注意力。
连绵起伏的山脉，奔腾不息的江河，广袤无垠的森林……这些都是那么的新奇。
一天之后，秦枫的心彻底放松了下来，开始兴致勃勃地欣赏起沿途的风景。
飞舟飞行了整整五天，终于抵达了云鼎山脉。云鼎山脉常年云雾缭绕，山峰高耸入云，空气中弥漫着浓郁的雷电之力。这里，正是雷云兽的栖息地。七人下了飞舟，在秦一帆的带领下，小心翼翼地进入了密林。雷云兽的嗅觉和听觉都极为灵敏，众人不敢大意，纷纷收敛了气息，小心前行。只用了小半天的时间，他们便在一处山谷中，发现了目标——一只正在玩耍的雷云兽幼崽。这只雷云兽幼崽虽然只有筑基初期的修为，但身上散发出来的雷电之力，却比同阶的妖兽要狂暴得多。
“就是它！”秦一帆眼中闪过一丝兴奋，压低声音说道，“大家小心，按计划行事！”那位阵法师立刻上前，双手快速结印。
“起！”随着他一声低喝，周围的大地突然震动起来，一道道土黄色的符文从地面浮现，瞬间组成了一个庞大的困阵，将那只雷云兽幼崽牢牢地困在了其中。
“动手！”秦一帆一声令下，七人同时出手。
各种术法和武技如同雨点般落下，火光、冰锥、雷电、土刺交织在一起，瞬间淹没了那只雷云兽幼崽。
雷云兽幼崽发出一声凄厉的惨叫，在困阵中疯狂挣扎，但终究寡不敌众。片刻之后，惨叫声戛然而止。雷云兽幼崽倒在了血泊之中，彻底失去了生机。
秦一帆松了一口气，笑道：“搞定！大家小心一点，先将它的尸体收起来，然后我们立刻离开这里，免得引来成年雷云兽！”
众人纷纷点头，正准备动手，却突然听到一声震天动地的怒吼，从云鼎山脉的深处传来。

“吼——！”
这声怒吼中，充满了无尽的悲愤和狂暴的杀意，震得整个山谷都在微微颤抖。众人脸色大变。“不好！是成年雷云兽！”秦一帆脸色惨白，失声说道，“大家快逃！＂话音未落，一道庞大的身影便从云层中俯冲而下，瞬间出现在山谷上空。
这是一只体型巨大无比的雷云兽，体长超过十丈，全身覆盖着厚厚的灰白色鳞片，鳞片间闪烁着刺眼的电弧。它的双眼如同两轮血月，死死地盯着山谷中雷云兽幼崽的尸体，身上散发出的灵压，竟达金丹后期！强大的灵压如同泰山压顶般笼罩下来，七人瞬间被压得动弹不得，连呼吸都变得困难起来。
雷云兽看着倒在血泊中的幼崽，全身雷电瞬间暴涨，一道道粗壮的闪电在它周身环绕，发出“噼啪”的巨响。它猛地抬起一只巨大的爪子，爪子上布满了狂暴的雷电之力，带着毁天灭地的威势，朝着七人所在的位置，狠狠拍了下来。
“完了！”秦一帆心中一片绝望，闭上眼睛，等待着死亡的降临。
秦枫也被这股强大的灵压压得浑身发麻，根本无法动弹。他看着那只带着雷电和怒火的巨掌，心中闪过一丝不甘。难道，自己就要死在这里了吗？就在这千钧一发之际，秦枫胸口处，那枚一直佩戴着的玉坠，突然毫无征兆地亮了起来。一道柔和却又无比强大的灵光，从玉坠中爆发而出。紧接着，一道模糊的虚影，缓缓从玉坠中浮现，最终化作了老祖的模样。老祖的虚影盘膝坐在半空中，身上散发着元婴后期大圆满的恐怖灵压。他只是淡淡地看了那只雷云兽一眼，便抬起右手，轻轻一伸。
“砰！”一声巨响，老祖的手掌与雷云兽的巨掌，在半空中轰然相撞。狂暴的能量冲击波瞬间扩散开来，将周围的树木全部掀飞，地面也被震出了一道道巨大的裂缝。
雷云兽只觉得一股无法抗拒的巨力从掌心传来，庞大的身躯竟被震得连连后退，口中喷出一口鲜血，眼中充满了难以置信的神色。它怎么也想不到，在这偏僻的云顶山脉，竟然会遇到如此强大的存在！老祖的虚影面无表情，右手猛地一抓。
“噗！”
那只金丹后期的雷云兽，甚至连反应的机会都没有，就被老祖的虚影一把抓住了脖颈。
“咔嚓！”
随着一声脆响，雷云兽的脖颈被硬生生捏断，庞大的身躯软软地垂了下来。紧接着，老祖的虚影五指一用力。
“轰！”
雷云兽的身体瞬间爆碎开来，化作一团血雾，只剩下一枚闪烁着雷电光芒的内丹，静静地悬浮在半空中。
老祖的虚影一挥手，那枚雷兽内丹便飘向了秦枫，最终落在了他的手中。
做完这一切，老祖的虚影身上的光芒开始渐渐黯淡下来。显然，刚才那一击，几乎耗尽了玉佩中储存的全部灵力。
“小枫……”老祖的虚影看着秦枫，嘴唇动了动，似乎想说什么，但最终只是摇了摇头，身影便如同泡沫般，缓缓消散在空气中。

On the sixth day after the game, when Qin Feng passed by the gate of the mission hall within the sect, he met Qin Yifan, a descendant of a branch of the Qin family. Qin Yifan has already reached the early stage of foundation building. Qin Feng occasionally saw him at clan gatherings and he seemed familiar.
At this time, Qin Yifan was standing in front of the bulletin board outside the mission hall, frowning at a mission notice. The notice read: Go to the Yunding Mountains and hunt down a Thunder Cloud Beast cub in the early stages of foundation building. Mission reward: 1,000 contribution points and a mortal level-breaking elixir. Qin Yifan's eyes lit up when he saw Qin Feng, and he quickly came over and greeted him warmly: "Qin Feng? Are you here to take over the mission too?" Qin Feng shook his head and said with a smile: "I just took a look."
Qin Yifan hesitated for a moment, then said: "Qin Feng, I am forming a team now, preparing to complete the task of hunting down the cubs of the Thunder Cloud Beast. We already have six people, and there is still one missing. Do you want to join us?" He paused, and then added: "Although your cultivation is only at the tenth level of Qi training, I know that your real combat power is definitely no worse than that of ordinary foundation-building monks. With you joining us, our confidence will be much greater." Qin Feng's heart moved. He has been practicing within the sect these years and has rarely had the opportunity to truly face monsters from the outside world. This mission not only allowed him to find a partner to practice with, but also allowed him to see the world outside the sect, which was extremely attractive to him.
"Okay." He agreed without hesitation, "Count me in."
Qin Yifan was overjoyed: "Great! Let's meet at the mountain gate early tomorrow morning and set off on the flying boat!"
Early the next morning, Qin Feng, Qin Yifan and other seven people met at the mountain gate. Accompanying him were five other foundation-building disciples, one of whom was an array master. The seven people exchanged a few words and then boarded the flying boat provided by the sect together. The flying boat rose into the sky and turned into a stream of light, flying towards the Yunding Mountains in the northeast.
No one noticed that after the flying boat flew out, a vague dark shadow in Zihui Pavilion flashed past, and then turned into a subtle stream of light, quietly following behind the flying boat.
At first, Qin Feng was a little panicked after leaving the sect. He has grown up in Jade Dragon Fairy Mountain since he can remember, and has never left the sect for more than ten years. Now, suddenly having to go to a strange place, he was inevitably a little nervous.
But as the flying boat continued to move forward, those strange sights gradually attracted his attention.
The rolling mountains, the rushing rivers, the vast forests... these are all so novel.
One day later, Qin Feng completely relaxed and began to enjoy the scenery along the way with great interest.
The flying boat flew for five full days and finally arrived at the Yunding Mountains. The Yunding Mountains are shrouded in clouds and mist all year round, with towering peaks reaching into the clouds, and the air filled with the power of thunder and lightning. This is the habitat of the Thunder Cloud Beast. The seven people got off the flying boat and, led by Qin Yifan, carefully entered the dense forest. The thunder cloud beast's sense of smell and hearing are extremely sensitive, so everyone did not dare to be careless, so they restrained their breath and moved forward carefully. It only took them half a day to find their target in a valley - a Thunder Cloud Beast cub playing. Although this thundercloud beast cub only has the cultivation level of the early stage of foundation building, the power of thunder and lightning emanating from it is much more violent than that of monster beasts of the same level.
"That's it!" Qin Yifan's eyes flashed with excitement, and he lowered his voice and said, "Everyone, be careful and act according to plan!" The formation master immediately stepped forward and quickly formed seals with his hands.
"Get up!" As he shouted, the surrounding ground suddenly shook, and earth-yellow runes emerged from the ground, instantly forming a huge trap, trapping the Thunder Cloud Beast cub firmly in it.
"Do it!" Qin Yifan gave the order, and seven people took action at the same time.
Various spells and martial arts are like rainFalling down like dots, fire, ice picks, thunder and lightning, and earth thorns intertwined together, instantly drowning the Thunder Cloud Beast cub.
The Thunder Cloud Beast cub let out a shrill scream and struggled wildly in the trapped formation, but in the end it was outnumbered. After a moment, the screams suddenly stopped. The Thunder Cloud Beast cub fell in a pool of blood, completely losing its vitality.
Qin Yifan breathed a sigh of relief and said with a smile: "It's done! Everyone, be careful and put away its body first, and then we leave here immediately to avoid attracting the adult Thunder Cloud Beast!"
Everyone nodded and were about to take action when they suddenly heard a thundering roar coming from the depths of the Yunding Mountains.
"Ho--!"
This roar was filled with endless grief, anger and violent murderous intent, causing the entire valley to tremble slightly. Everyone's expressions changed drastically. "No! It's an adult Thunder Cloud Beast!" Qin Yifan's face turned pale and he lost his voice, "Everyone, run away!" Before he finished speaking, a huge figure swooped down from the clouds and appeared over the valley in an instant.
This is an extremely huge Thunder Cloud Beast, more than ten feet long. Its whole body is covered with thick gray-white scales, and dazzling electric arcs flash between the scales. Its eyes were like two blood moons, staring intently at the body of the Thunder Cloud Beast cub in the valley. The spiritual pressure emitted from its body reached the late stage of the Golden Core! The powerful spiritual pressure shrouded them like a mountain, and the seven people were instantly suppressed, unable to move, and even breathing became difficult.
The thunder cloud beast looked at the cub lying in a pool of blood, and the thunder and lightning all over its body suddenly surged. Thick lightning bolts surrounded it, making a loud "crackling" sound. It suddenly raised a huge paw, which was filled with violent thunder and lightning power. With the power of destroying the world, it fiercely slapped down the location of the seven people.
"It's over!" Qin Yifan felt desperate, closed his eyes, and waited for death to come.
Qin Feng was also numbed by this powerful spiritual pressure and could not move at all. He looked at the giant palm with thunder and anger, and a trace of unwillingness flashed in his heart. Could it be that I am going to die here? At this critical moment, the jade pendant he had been wearing on Qin Feng's chest suddenly lit up without warning. A soft but extremely powerful spiritual light burst out from the jade pendant. Immediately afterwards, a blurry shadow slowly emerged from the jade pendant, and finally transformed into the appearance of the ancestor. The phantom of the ancestor sat cross-legged in mid-air, exuding the terrifying spiritual pressure of the Great Perfection in the late Nascent Soul. He just glanced at the thunder cloud beast lightly, then raised his right hand and stretched it slightly.
"Bang!" There was a loud noise, and the ancestor's palm and the thunder cloud beast's giant palm collided in mid-air. The violent energy shock wave spread instantly, flying all the surrounding trees away, and the ground was shaken with huge cracks.
The Thunder Cloud Beast only felt an irresistible force coming from the palm of its hand, and its huge body was shocked back again and again. A mouthful of blood spurted out from its mouth, and its eyes were full of disbelief. It never imagined that it would encounter such a powerful existence in this remote Yunding Mountains! The shadow of the ancestor showed no expression, and he grabbed it with his right hand.
"Poof!"
The Thunder Cloud Beast in the late Golden Core stage didn't even have a chance to react before it was grabbed by the neck by the shadow of its ancestor.
"Crack!"
With a crisp sound, the Thunder Cloud Beast's neck was violently pinched, and its huge body hung limply. Immediately afterwards, the phantom of the ancestor exerted force with five fingers.
"Boom!"
The body of the Thunder Cloud Beast exploded instantly and turned into a ball of blood mist, leaving only an inner elixir shining with thunder and lightning, floating quietly in mid-air.
The phantom of the ancestor waved his hand, and the thunder beast inner elixir floated towards Qin Feng, and finally fell into his hand.
After doing all this, the light on the ancestor's shadow began to gradually dim. Obviously, the blow just now almost exhausted the jade pendant.All the spiritual power stored in it.
"Xiao Feng..." The phantom of the ancestor looked at Qin Feng, his lips moved, as if he wanted to say something, but in the end he just shook his head, and the figure slowly dissipated in the air like bubbles.
